build_infogan_module: build a PyTorch Lightning InfoGAN module with generator, discriminator, and optimizer configs
train_infogan_generator: train the InfoGAN generator by calling generator_step to fool the discriminator
train_infogan_discriminator: train the InfoGAN discriminator by calling discriminator_step to classify real and fake images
compute_info_loss: compute the InfoGAN information loss using categorical and continuous code prediction losses
generate_sample_images: generate sample images with varied latent codes using generate_sample_image method
